build.beforeDevCommand: npm run build:server && npm run dev
build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run build:server && npm run build

security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Mirror an Android screen over USB
bundle.longDescription: Stormcast mirrors the screen of an Android device to Windows over USB, using the scrcpy server on the device.
